notes.title: Update 1.5.31. Future plans, free DLC.
notes.content: [p]We are pleased to announce the release of a major update, 1.5.31. A lot of work has been done.[/p][p]The patch took a very long time to prepare, and we would like to apologize once again. The long development time was due to the fact that we completely rewrote the project structure in order to make future patches faster and easier to work with. In addition, we had broken saves, achievements, and many critical issues that we have been fixing all this time.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40049939/332a4da7d2cb3d39860cd039afef816bbe5a4c11.png"][/img][/p][p]Some important features have also been added, and a free add-on that allows you to open a hotel next to a cafe is half finished. We are currently working on the add-on, and soon everyone will be able to get it for free and expand their business.[/p][p][/p][p]Next on the agenda is to review the game mechanics, animations, interface, and much more, which we are already working on![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40049939/17d81f0f53327e074dfcb9c21ea3ee1eaaefb74b.png"][/img][/p][h3]Major changes:[/h3][p][/p][p]• Added a seaside level, now you can open a cafe on the beach overlooking the ocean;[/p][p]• Fixed saves;[/p][p]• Work is underway on the Cafe Owner Simulator Hotel DLC;[/p][p]• Fishing and catching fish mechanics;[/p][p]• Crab catching;[/p][p]• Added 5 new seafood dishes;[/p][p]• Game saves are now available in multiple slots.[/p][p]• Cloud saves in Steam Cloud.[/p][p]• Improved balance of visitor reviews.[/p][p]• Added more variety to review texts.[/p][p]• Game balance changes (changed prices in the store and some rewards).[/p][p]• More tasks are now available to complete;[/p][p]• Fixed some critical issues with tornadoes;[/p][p]• Added a club at sea level, now in the evenings your visitors can have a good time listening to loud music in the club on the -1 floor of your establishment;[/p][p]• Items could sometimes get stuck in the air, such as vases with flowers — fixed;[/p][p]• Added emotion panels for visitors.[/p][p]• Changed employee avatars.[/p][p]• Added sounds of footsteps on different surfaces.[/p][p]• Reduced and balanced the brightness of materials.[/p][p]• Added textures for colorful materials, now the painted wall surface is not as smooth and looks more realistic;[/p][p]• Added the sale of pies in the cafe (cafe-bar) instead of removing them;[/p][p]• Changed the weather system, lighting has become more realistic, weather and effects;[/p][p]• Added an “overflow” shader in the pop-up window when buying or selling;[/p][p]• New, more realistic water;[/p][p]• Added hotkeys for actions in the bottom panel, where you can move objects, hire an employee, sell installed equipment, etc;[/p][p]• Added the ability to change the lighting level in lamps.[/p][p]• The cleaner could approach trash that had been cleaned up by the player — fixed.[/p][p]• Limited the height of urinal installation.[/p][p]• Fixed a bug with the waiter, now he only serves food if the customer is seated at the table.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40049939/c9f738570adc7c9665dcd7c790ee7151a7696cfa.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40049939/36de529e74f9b42fa6d3c85c5ad6eea4ed7ea0ea.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Development Diary. Announcement of free DLC.
Major patch 1.4.105 + Farm DLC!
notes.content:
[b]Dear cafe owners,[/b]

We are pleased to announce the release of a major patch for Cafe Owner Simulator, containing many improvements and exciting new features that will enhance your gameplay. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2742990/Cafe_Owner_Simulator__Farm_DLC/

This update brings significant improvements including a new user interface, a wide selection of new furniture and improved animations for both customers and employees. In addition, we have addressed several critical issues to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable game play. Below is a detailed list of additions and fixes included in this update:

[h2]Added:[/h2]

- New user interface
- Lots of new furniture
- New animations for customers and workers
- Customers can now sit at tables together instead of one per table
- Improved paint system

[h2]Fixed:[/h2]

- Textures have been optimized, and RAM and VRAM usage has also been optimized
- The game would sometimes crash when trying to remove debris or leaves
- Game crashed due to tornado issues
- Sometimes, after taking a customer's order, the customer would get stuck and the game would crash
- Player could not move green dishes to the menu if there were no green ingredients for them
- Various notification issues
- Some UI elements overlap with others
- Font size issues on different resolutions
- An issue that caused Avazon to sometimes not work in mail missions
- Critical popcorn issue where ordering popcorn blocked the cooking process
- Problems with hamburgers and doner related products and green highlighting on the menu screen
- Problems with some dishes and their ingredients
- Unable to paint some parts of the ceiling in post jobs
- Fixed some translations
- Problems with using tools, in particular pressing F, G and RMB
- Problems with repairing windows in post jobs 4 and 5
- Clients would sometimes appear in the wrong place
- Players had free space in the fridge but could not buy ingredients
- Trash on tables was not accounted for in the trash user interface
- Post missions 5 and 6 incorrectly displayed new logos after completion
- In post mission 7, the player could pick up trash in the cafe next to the door
- UI issue with achievement screen on ultra-wide screens
- When starting the game from the beginning without saves, the game asked to delete old saves
- Critical issue where furniture would disappear when loading the game
- Problem with current weather indicator texts
- Tiles are often not highlighted when placing floors
- Debris on new tables levitates in the air
- After a tornado, some players could not find trash
- If all kitchen furniture and tables were placed before a task with smoke detectors, the task with food boxes did not progress.

We are also happy to announce that our team is hard at work on the next patch, which will feature new levels and new post missions. These additions are designed to bring new challenges and exciting content to make your experience in Cafe Owner Simulator dynamic and enjoyable.

Thank you for your continued support and valuable feedback. Stay tuned for updates and happy running!

[i][b]Best wishes,  
Second Reality team.
[/b][/i]

notes.title: Devlog 1.0.248 - New Level and Localization Fixes!
notes.content:
Hello dear players,

We're back with another update! This time we're mainly focusing on gameplay fixes and a lot of enhancements to the game's localization. Not only that, we've also added an exciting new level for restoration and repair to keep you engaged.

We understand that there are still critical problems that need to be addressed and we assure you that those are high on our list for the next update. We're also working on an additional level for restoration with fresh and interesting tasks for you to tackle.

And that's not all! We're also planning to add more furniture options for you to design your cafe exactly how you envision it. Furthermore, we have some intriguing new mechanics in the pipeline that we're eager to share. Stay tuned for future updates!

[h3]Here's a rundown of the changes in version 1.0.248:[/h3]

[b]Added a new level mission for restoration and interior decoration.[/b]

Get ready to put your designing skills to the test in this new challenge.
NOTE: New mail mission are unlocked after the Sushi feast.

[b]Fixed language change issue.[/b]

The issue where the language in the pause menu wouldn't translate the task correctly on the level of additional tasks has been addressed.

[b]Improved furniture collision.[/b]

The issues with the collision of some new furniture added in the last patch have been fixed.

[b]Localization fixes.[/b]

We've made many improvements in the localization of the game to enhance your playing experience.

[b]Fixed snowman disappearing issue.[/b]

Snowmen will no longer disappear at a certain distance. Snowy seasons just got merrier!

[b]Adjusted food selling mechanic.[/b]

The issue where ingredients were not being deducted when selling food at the food truck has been resolved.

[b]Task progression bug fixed.[/b]

After selling 15 sushi, the game did not give a new task - this issue has been fixed.

[b]Fixed bugs on new game task (separate level).[/b]

We've addressed several bugs on the new game task to ensure smooth gameplay.

[b]Fixed homeless person interaction.[/b]

When meeting a homeless person for the first time, if the player did not approach him, the homeless person would stand indefinitely and not leave. This has been fixed.

Thank you for your continuous support and feedback. Remember, we're committed to delivering the best experience and we're always ready to hear your suggestions and feedback. Enjoy the new update, and happy gaming!

[b]Cheers,
The Cafe Owner Simulator Team[/b]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.242. Discount -35%. Lots of fixes and new features!
Survey results and plans for upcoming updates.
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who took part in the survey, everyone who hasn't yet - [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfYDz-7r2ClSsyC4mzkCHAV9VVRDoTK4YzuLoJTU8U5cBl1PQ/viewform]SURVEY[/url]

We received a lot of interesting ideas and feedback about the game based on the survey results, all of them were reviewed and we have already selected some of them to implement in the next updates, the rest - we will consider for implementation in future patches.

Based on your responses we have chosen these tasks for the next patches:
[list]
[*] [b]Some polishing/fixing of bugs[/b] - we're doing deep tests almost every day and reading all feedback from players, so we'll fix these bugs and will polish some mechanics.
[*][b]1-2 new tasks/levels of side jobs[/b]
[*][b]New furniture and surfaces[/b] - we're going to add new furniture and surfaces to paint.
[*][b]Some balancing in mechanics[/b].
[*][b]Food trucks zone near the cafe[/b] - you can buy and place food trucks to prepare and sell some fast-food. It will give you new possibilities to make more money, to expand your business, and expand territory around cafes.
[*][b]Season and holiday updates[/b] - some of you want to decorate cafe with holiday furniture or surfaces, it doesn't matter if it is holiday now or not, so we're going to add some specific holiday furniture and other things.
[/list]
Also, many voted for groups of visitors and families, we plan to add this feature to the game, but a little later, as this system is complicated and can affect the balance and create new bugs, but we are not discarding this option and think how to properly implement.

We plan to release the next patch within 2-4 weeks.
